scope: Generate one aggregate-only deterministic descriptive prior-predictive coherence report for the current neutral organization-level all-event industry baseline, using only the frozen configured priors and pure non-persisting simulation engine.

result_contract.required_disposition: OPT-014 remains open and data-gated; independently governed data acquisition or bounded closure remains a separate decision.

stop_conditions: Any protocol, audit-result, prior, configuration, pure-engine, store, lifecycle, branch, or HEAD digest/precondition differs from its frozen value.
Any source or identity-bearing repository, finding, assessment, label, incident, loss, or organization record would be read or emitted.
Any raw simulated draw would be persisted or any production-store row would be read beyond hashing, written, migrated, or reinterpreted.
Any of the seven frozen coherence checks fails, fixed-seed aggregate output is not deterministic, or an aggregate metric is nonfinite or outside its mathematical range.
Any validation, calibration, representativeness, decision-quality, remediation-value, or portfolio-optimality claim would be made.

Any fitting, model comparison, backtest, resample, threshold, new prior, hierarchy, category allocation, remediation effect, dependency, portfolio optimization, tuning, policy, lifecycle, OPT-010, branch, remote, or deployment action is attempted.
Any resource ceiling is reached or a focused offline test, JSON validation, digest check, or accounting invariant fails.
completion_boundary: After one aggregate artifact and one descriptive result are persisted with seven passing coherence checks, deterministic focused tests, and a byte-identical production store, stop. OPT-014 remains open/data-gated; no acquisition, fitting, validation, policy, lifecycle, branch, or deployment action is authorized.
